summary: Practise KPI design, data-quality checks and decision briefs in five days. Explore the course outline and see how it fits your role.
lede: Data-driven decision-making training helps team leaders, department heads and analysts turn workplace evidence into defensible choices. It covers checking data quality, building KPI trees, using Pareto analysis and the 5 Whys to investigate issues, and comparing options in A3 briefs. Learners also practise logging decisions and communicating assumptions, uncertainty and progress in leadership updates.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who make or support operational decisions and need to explain their evidence, assumptions and follow-up to colleagues or senior leaders.
audience: It is designed for foundation-level learners
You can apply the exercises to routine
prerequisites: No specialist analytics background or programming is required. Familiarity with routine workplace reports and basic spreadsheet use will help you complete the exercises; you can work with provided sample tables or adapt the activities to a suitable workplace example.
